issue.title: OraclePlatform - ORA-01427: single-row subquery returns more than one row
issue.body:
The "all_col_comments" table contains all column comments for all database tables in all tablespaces. If the connection user has access to multiple tablespaces, this query fails with the following error:
ORA-01427: single-row subquery returns more than one row

issue.title: Doctrine:Schema:Validate leeds to ORA-01427(single-row subquery returns more than one row)
issue.body:
Hi,
I have a problem on Oracle platform with the command doctrine:schema:validate with doctrine/dbal 2.5.5.

When I lauch the command I get the following error : 

```
  [Symfony\Component\Debug\Exception\ContextErrorException]
  Warning: oci_fetch_all(): ORA-01427: single-row subquery returns more than
  one row
```

I recently upgraded from doctrine/dbal 2.5.4 to doctrine/dbal 2.5.5 and I finally managed to found where the regretion(?) comes from.

It apparently comes from the change of (new) line 668 of the file OraclePlatform.php on this commit : https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/commit/a23a47115f0fa35cf349735dfe342e2715f97f30

It not only change style of the query but transform an innerJoin to a subquery.
The innerJoin allowed several line as subquery doesn't.

This would work perfectly fine if no column have more than on comment.
In my Database, I have several users and each user have a comment on my column. 
And the subquery fail.

This can be corrected By adding an other condition on the subquery to get current user comments only.

I'm working on a PR to show the fix and iterate.

issue.body:
```
PHP Warning:  oci_fetch_all(): ORA-01427: single-row subquery returns more than one row in /opt/kvk/WB/vendor/doctrine/dbal/lib/Doctrine/DBAL/Driver/OCI8/OCI8Statement.php on line 290
```

Synopsis: 
1. Create two databases accessible by current user
2. Add identical tables with same name in both databases
3. Try to get database schema (in my case I was running a migration)
